_comment: Starter podcast feeds for discovery. Content data, not UI copy — it lives
outside lib/ so the CJK literal gate does not see it.
The feed URL is the source id: for a podcast the feed address is the
stable thing to point at, and it is what entriesFor fetches.
Name, description and language are our curation, shown as such. They are
not read back from the feed, so keep them accurate by hand.
Every URL here was verified to answer 200 with a parseable RSS channel on
2026-08-04. Re-check before adding: a starter feed that 404s is the first

feeds.name: 6 Minute English
feeds.description: BBC Learning English. Six-minute conversations built for learners, with the vocabulary spelled out.

feeds.name: Learning English Conversations
feeds.description: BBC Learning English. Everyday dialogues at a measured pace, explained line by line.

feeds.name: Up First
feeds.description: NPR's morning news briefing. Native pace, roughly fifteen minutes, published every weekday.

feeds.name: Planet Money
feeds.description: NPR. Economics told as stories, with two or three speakers and a lot of natural interruption.

feeds.name: The Daily
feeds.description: The New York Times. One reported story a day, interview-led, at unhurried native pace.
